args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Bump the
pinned version to the fixed 2.9.4 release.

args.body:
## Summary
- Bumps the pinned fastjson dependency from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
The currently pinned version (fastjson 2.8.0) is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The fix is available in fastjson **2.9.4** (and 3.1.0 for the 3.x line). This PR upgrades to the minimal fixed version in the 2.x line: **2.9.4**.

## CI
CI ran on this branch (run `ci-0001`, commit `c8b8ab7878`) and passed.

## Reviewer
Requested review from @alex.
